recipes.name: Batch Baked Bone-In Chicken Thighs
ing: bone-in chicken thighs (skin removed after cooking)
steps: Preheat oven to 425F with racks in the middle and lower third. Line 3-4 sheet pans with foil or parchment.
Pat chicken completely dry.
Mix the salt and spices; season every piece on both sides.
Spread skin-up, not touching, on the pans.
Roast 40-45 min, swapping pans between racks at 20 min, until 175F.
Rest 10 min. Remove skin and pull meat off the bone for 5.5 oz portions (about 156 g); cool within 2 h and refrigerate.
recipes.notes: Bone-in thighs keep about 40% of purchased weight as cooked skinless meat, so 12 lb makes about 14 portions of 5.5 oz. Salt is about 3/4 tsp per lb. Swap the rub using the Seasoning guide.

recipes.name: Batch Boneless Skinless Thighs
steps: Heat oven to 425F; line a sheet pan.
Pat thighs dry; toss with oil and seasoning; spread with space between.
Roast 20-25 min to 175F; rest 5 min.
recipes.notes: About half the oven time of bone-in. Overcooking past 175F dries them.

recipes.name: Batch Poached Chicken Breast
steps: Place breasts in a single layer in a pot; cover with cold water; add salt, garlic and peppercorns.
Bring to a bare simmer over medium heat, then cover and turn the heat off.
Stand 15-18 min until 165F; slice or shred.
Store with a spoonful of the broth to stay moist.
recipes.notes: Very large breasts (over 10 oz) may need up to 25 minutes off heat, or cut them in half.

recipes.name: Batch Roasted Drumsticks
steps: Heat oven to 425F with a rack over a sheet pan.
Pat dry; toss with baking powder, salt and spices.
Roast, turning once, 35-45 min to 175F; cool and refrigerate within 2 h.
recipes.notes: 4 drumsticks per serving.

recipes.name: Batch Browned Ground Beef
steps: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add meat in one layer; leave 1-2 min to brown; break apart and cook to 160F, 8-10 min.
Season; spoon off excess fat; cool before refrigerating.
recipes.notes: Browning in two batches avoids steaming.

recipes.name: Batch Ground Turkey Crumbles
steps: Brown turkey in oil, breaking it up; cook to 165F.
Season with salt, garlic powder and paprika.
recipes.notes: Add 1/4 cup broth if it looks dry.

recipes.name: Batch Cooked White Rice
steps: Rinse rice in a strainer 30 seconds.
Combine rice, water and salt in a pot with a tight lid; bring to a boil.
Reduce to lowest heat, cover, and cook 18 min without lifting the lid.
Rest 5 min covered; fluff; spread on a sheet pan to cool before storing.
recipes.notes: 1 cup dry makes about 3 cups cooked (1 serving = 1 cup cooked). Water ratio 1.5:1; big batches evaporate less, so drop to about 1.4:1 above 8 cups dry. Cool within 2 h; keeps 3-4 days.

recipes.name: Batch Sheet-Pan Potatoes
steps: Heat oven to 425F; cut potatoes in 3/4 in pieces.
Toss with oil and seasoning; spread in one layer.
Roast 30-35 min, flipping once.
recipes.notes: Cheap alternative to rice.

recipes.name: Batch Roasted Vegetables
steps: Heat oven to 425F; cut vegetables to uniform sizes.
Toss with oil, salt and pepper; spread on pans.
Roast 20-30 min, flipping once.
recipes.notes: Roast hard vegetables (carrots) 10 min before soft ones.

recipes.name: Boiled Egg Snack Pack
steps: Boil 11-12 min; ice bath; refrigerate in the shell.
recipes.notes: 2 eggs per serving; keeps 7 days.

recipes.name: Chicken Rice Bowl
steps: Layer rice, chicken and vegetables in a microwave-safe container.
Drizzle soy sauce and honey.
Microwave 90 seconds, stir, then 30 seconds more until steaming hot (165F).
recipes.notes: Swap the sauce or rub to change the flavor. Breast instead of thigh: about 30 kcal fewer and 8 g more protein.

recipes.name: Tuna Rice Bowl
ing: can (5 oz) light tuna in water, drained
steps: Drain the tuna well.
Put rice in a bowl; add tuna and vegetables; drizzle soy and honey and mix.
recipes.notes: Zero-cook fallback.

recipes.name: Pre-Race / Long-Run Carb Bowl
steps: Combine warm rice and chicken; drizzle honey and soy; salt lightly.
Eat 3-4 hours before the start, or as dinner the night before.
recipes.notes: Low fat and fiber. Scale rice up for bigger carb-loading meals (1-4 g/kg carbs 1-4 h before; 8-12 g/kg/day for the 36-48 h before a marathon).

recipes.name: Burrito Bowl (any protein)
steps: Layer rice, beans, protein and corn.
Top with salsa; microwave 90 seconds; squeeze lime.
recipes.notes: Beans add about 110 kcal and 7 g protein per 1/2 cup.

recipes.name: Teriyaki Chicken Bowl
steps: Whisk soy, honey and vinegar.
Steam or microwave the broccoli 3 minutes.
Assemble bowl and pour sauce over; heat.

recipes.name: Greek Chicken Bowl
steps: Assemble; mix yogurt with lemon for the sauce.

recipes.name: Overnight Oats with PB and Whey
steps: Add oats, milk, yogurt and whey to a jar; stir hard until no lumps.
Add the banana slices.
Seal and refrigerate overnight. Eat cold or microwave 60-90 seconds.
recipes.notes: Make up to 4 jars at a time (keeps 3-4 days in the fridge). Do not freeze.

recipes.name: PB Banana Power Shake
steps: Add milk and whey to the blender first (liquid at the bottom).
Add banana, peanut butter and ice; blend 45-90 seconds.

recipes.name: Baked Oatmeal Cups
steps: Mix everything.
Fill 12 greased muffin cups; bake 350F 22-25 min.
recipes.notes: Freezes 2-3 months; 2 cups per serving.

recipes.name: Greek Yogurt Parfait
steps: Layer yogurt, berries and granola; drizzle honey.

recipes.name: Freezer Breakfast Burritos
ing: breakfast sausage or cooked turkey crumbles
steps: Scramble the eggs with salt; cool.
Fill tortillas with eggs, meat, cheese and beans; roll tightly.
Wrap individually; freeze up to 3 months. Reheat from frozen 2-3 min in the microwave.

recipes.name: Protein Pancakes
steps: Blend everything until smooth.
Cook 1/4 cup scoops on a medium griddle 2-3 min per side.
recipes.notes: Freezes well.

recipes.name: PB Banana Toast
steps: Toast; spread with peanut butter; top with banana.

recipes.name: Oat Energy Bites
steps: Stir everything; chill 30 minutes; roll into 12 balls.
recipes.notes: Keeps 7 days refrigerated; freezes 3 months.

recipes.name: Chicken Hummus Wrap
steps: Spread hummus; add chicken and vegetables; roll.

recipes.name: Lentil Bean Chili
steps: Sauté onion, pepper and garlic 2 minutes.
Add cumin, chili powder and cinnamon 15 seconds.
Add tomatoes, water and brown lentils; boil, then simmer 40 minutes.
Add beans and corn 5 more minutes.
Off heat, stir in red lentils; cover 15 minutes.
recipes.notes: Calories and macros are calculated from the ingredients. About $1 per serving; freezes 4 months.

recipes.name: White Bean and Sausage Soup
steps: Brown sausage; add onion and garlic.
Add broth, beans and seasoning; simmer 15 min; add kale 5 min.

recipes.name: Beef and Vegetable Soup
steps: Brown beef with onion.
Add everything else; simmer 30-40 min.
recipes.notes: Freezes 3 months.
